title: Elysiaa
hook: This site: a hand-built WebGL world with custom shaders, a day/night cycle and a wanderer.
text: This world. Built for no one but curiosity — a place to test what shaders, pixels and a stubborn idea can become.
highlights: Three.js scene with custom GLSL atmosphere and post-processing.
Hand-illustrated parallax plates and a layered wanderer.
A day/night cycle tied to the site theme.

caseStudy.problem: A portfolio should feel like the work it shows. A template would have contradicted everything this site is meant to prove.
caseStudy.approach: I built the world from scratch: a Three.js scene, custom shaders, layered art plates and a day/night system, all behind a plain HTML content layer so the writing stays editable.
caseStudy.outcome: The site you are reading is the project. It runs in the browser with no video and no pre-rendered background.
caseStudy.learned: Atmosphere is mostly restraint. The expensive-looking moments came from timing, light and negative space, not from more geometry.
